how: Opened the public ChatGPT share page and selected the longest assistant answer (deeply nested lists with emoji) from its first block to its last with a DOM range (what a mouse drag over the answer yields), then ran document.execCommand("copy").
notes: Selection capture (DOM range + execCommand('copy')), so it is Chrome's serialization: org.chromium.source-url is the page URL, every element carries a computed inline style=, the first block starts with <br class="Apple-interchange-newline">, and plain text is the rendered text (UI labels such as 'Thought for ...' / 'Worked for ...' can lead it; tokens of rendered math sit on separate lines). Code blocks lose their language-* classes in this path. Deeply nested lists (25 <ul>, 132 <li>), 23 emoji, a table and code. Same assistant turn as the copy-button fixture of the same name.
